'''Kallaaddik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a bodyguard of [[Ryssa Jadeonar]] and the two visited [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[3643 BBY]], where they were killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kallaaddik appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a hostile NPC on the Republic version of Taris.
